復讐心に付け込まれ、数え切れないほどの
命を奪った女だ。恐れられて当然だろう。
text.official_en:
It's to be expected. I did let my hunger for vengeance
claim countless lives.

……あなたの、ダグザ大帝を憎む気持ちはわかるわ。

text.official_en:
I understand hating Dagda the Great. I was born in
Kunlun, so I empathize.

text.official_en:
You don't need to try to console me. I spent nine
hundred years consumed with hatred for that man.

I let it get more important than caring for my family.
It's no surprise that I'm disliked.

children to sanctuary in Damascar.
